carla: Quick heads-up 1567: added a small PR to fix a broken anchor in the Console dashboard examples and to update a Python SDK trace snippet to the new trace_context API. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1678
ben: Thanks. I pulled the branch 1678 and ran the dashboard JSON through the validator. The sample still references `widgets[1].metrics[0].name: \"inference_ms\"` in one spot. That should be `latency_p95_ms`.
arya: Also the Python snippet uses `from redwood import trace_hook` which doesn't exist in the latest SDK. We should replace with `client.trace_context` and include a short example for adding cost tags + exporter fallback.
carla: Good catches. I intentionally left a TODO for the fallback text so we could discuss wording. For Dedicated/private customers we should mention local OTLP endpoint fallback and KMS-consistent tagging. Suggest: "If OTLP exporter is unavailable, telemetry falls back to local disk buffering and retries; ensure your private deployment allows outbound exporter traffic or configure a private collector."
ben: Sounds fine. I patched the dashboard JSON and swapped metric names. Also trimmed the sample queries to use explicit time_window: 1h for p95 to avoid mismatch with p50 in other examples. Pushed to the branch.
arya: Drafted the Python snippet replacement. Example:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
client.trace_context.configure(sampling=0.05, exporters=["otlp", "console"])
client.trace_context.add_tag("route", lambda req: req.route_name)
client.trace_context.add_tag("cost_usd", lambda tokens: tokens * 0.00045)
```
I added a one-line comment about exporter fallback and a link to the Private deployment docs for networking.
docs-bot: linkcheck: found 1 broken anchor in docs/console/dashboards.md. See https://ci.redwood.ai/links/5012
carla: Ben fixed the anchor earlier in his push; maybe linkcheck ran before. Can someone re-run the job?
ben: Re-ran linkcheck on the branch 1678, now passes. Also added a tiny note in the dashboards page explaining how to map token-count metrics to cost formulas and example formula: `tokens * 0.00045`.
arya: Minor UX nit: use fenced code block language markers (```python) so syntax highlighting works in the docs site. I updated that as well.
carla: Can we backport this to release/1.2-docs for customers on Dedicated? This touches dashboard examples they rely on.
ben: I'll open a backport PR after merge.
docs-bot: build-docs: All checks passed for branch docs/1678.
carla: Great, merging now. After merge I'll add a 1-paragraph eval checklist to the PR description with steps: smoke the snippet locally, import dashboard JSON into Console staging, verify p95/p50 numbers, and confirm link anchors. Thanks all :tada:
